landsat.harmonization: no silent spectral harmonization across sensors; if fewer valid dates exist than desired, record the deficit honestly

phenology.window_note: identical to the frozen Issue #19 V2 predeclared autumn window; target DOY is a tie-break only

sentinel1.threshold_widen_rule: the primary 7-day threshold is not widened after seeing support; any wider sensitivity tier must be frozen before training as a separate tier
sentinel1.unpaired_optical_rule: if no <=7 day pair exists, preserve the optical sample and mark the modality slot UNAVAILABLE; the optical sample is never dropped
sentinel1.validity_definition: finite VV AND finite VH AND both values > -70 dB on the landed grid

sentinel2.spread_rule: selected datatakes must be spread across the predeclared window; near-duplicate dates are forbidden; ranking is deterministic (cloud asc, |doy-target| asc, event_id asc) after a predeclared date-spacing partition of the window

views.multi_date_representation_freeze: The deterministic MULTI_DATE_SEASONAL representation (date ordering, missingness, QA propagation, aggregation rule, band semantics) is frozen in Phase F BEFORE any training; candidate forms are temporal stack, robust median/medoid, and fixed-date-slot stack with missing masks. The choice is made on data semantics only, never on model performance.

fresh_test_reserve.membership: new cells only (not Stage-1 panel cells)
fresh_test_reserve.name: V0_2_FRESH_NEW_CELL_TEST_RESERVE
fresh_test_reserve.note: final train/val/test roles are frozen by the future v0.2 protocol after acquisition QA completes, without revisiting Stage-1 performance

hard_scope_caps.owner_review_stop: projected scope exceeding ANY cap stops for owner review; scientific support is not silently weakened to fit the caps

production_contracts.guard: ee.batch.Export guard; metadata-only census has zero pixel exports
production_contracts.reuse: Issue #19 V2 production contracts (national_pilot_event_plan_v2 / pilot19 export)

scientific_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Issue #20 / Stage 1 must not be stated to prove that model capacity is sufficient.
scientific_interpretation.stage1_statement: Within-scene separability exists, but the current benchmark support is too weak to attribute cross-scene/temporal collapse to model capacity.

forbidden: any model prediction or model-derived feature
Stage-1 failure maps, error maps, or per-cell errors
model uncertainty, confidence, or calibration outputs
Stage-1 test/evaluation performance of any kind
label appearance or content visible in downloaded imagery
any redesign of the panel after seeing imagery or pixels
legal: frozen W10 geography and registry (W10_DOMAIN_V1_CORE_FROZEN, production_eligible=true)
target-independent region/province groups and coastal-segment attribution
named label-source presence/area: GEODATA 1990/2000/2015/2020, CMSA 2017-2021 (gridcode=2 positive), CM-SSM 2020 (external-reference only, never a training/tuning label)
Issue #18 pre-model agreement/disagreement strata (exclusive_stratum / agreement categories)
patch/area class derived from named label products
EO availability and QA metadata from the metadata-only national census (event counts, coverage basis, cloud metadata); no pixels

stage1_panel.note: the original 20 Issue #19/#20 cells are development and instrumentation only for v0.2; inspected Stage-1 test/witness cells are excluded from the pristine primary v0.2 test reserve

support_goals.attainability_policy: Goals are never forced. If a requirement cannot be met from the frozen inputs, the maximum attainable support and the shortfall are reported honestly; no threshold is relaxed after seeing imagery or model outputs.

cmsa_temporal.background_comparability_note: 'comparable background/control support' is predeclared to mean at least the same cell count as the positive target
cmsa_temporal.positive_definition: gridcode=2 CMSA polygon presence/area in BOTH 2020 and 2021 for the same W10 cell; gridcode=0 polygons are UNKNOWN and never count as positive or background evidence

cross_region.region_definition: target-independent province attribution (Natural Earth 10 m admin-1 v5.1.1; centroid-in-province, else unique nearest province within 25 km with a >300 m second-province margin, else UNKNOWN); UNKNOWN cannot anchor a holdout

geodata_temporal.positive_definition: named GEODATA Spartina presence/area in BOTH 2015 and 2020 for the same W10 cell (national 30 m product; fractional area support, no synthetic upsampling)

near_synchronous.gap_semantics: absolute |S2 date - S1 date| in calendar days
near_synchronous.simultaneous_rule: a pair is called 'simultaneous' only when the gap is exactly 0 days; otherwise the numeric gap is reported
